collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: The strongest villager could haul the heavy fishing net in alone, but several younger villagers are eager to learn how.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), the strongest villager, could haul the heavy fishing net in alone, but several younger villagers are eager to learn how.

choices.label: Step Back and Let Them Try.
Let Them Practice on a Smaller Net First.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The young villagers struggle but succeed, glowing with pride.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The net is too heavy for them, and the strong villager steps in only for the last pull.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The young ones learn to brace and pull together.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The lesson takes so long that the tide goes out with half the net still in the water.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The net comes in quickly, and everyone shares the credit.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Everyone pulls in a different rhythm, and they collapse laughing in the sand.

text_only.reason: a small thing breaks in the story; no building is damaged -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The youngsters build skill without strain.

text_only.reason: "experience" / "skill" in the everyday sense, not a skill gain -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One youngster is insulted by the small net and insists on the big one next time.
